create_TreescopeFigure: create a TreescopeFigure to render a Treescope part as an IPython figure with HTML and pretty representations
build_InlineBlock: build an InlineBlock span group to render child content in inline-block CSS mode
build_AllowWordWrap: build an AllowWordWrap span group to allow line breaks in its child content with pre-wrap whitespace
build_PreventWordWrap: build a PreventWordWrap span group to prevent line breaks in its child content with pre whitespace
review_TreescopeFigure_repr_html_: review the TreescopeFigure _repr_html_ method that renders the child part as compressed HTML for IPython
